big: Meena buys a flat in Pune for her parents. Rent from it flows in monthly, and the tenant deducts tax before paying. Years later she sells it. The money lands in an NRO account, and sending it abroad needs paperwork.

lines: What can an NRI buy in India, and what happens to the money later?

Residential and commercial property, yes. Agricultural land, plantations and farmhouses, no. Rent is taxed and tax is deducted at source. Sale money sits in NRO, and sending it abroad is limited each year.
